description.purpose: Investigate and correct two omitted APY components in Elena Park’s first Silver savings interest payment, with an unscored backend-referral invocation.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Elena Park, a 33-year-old software support specialist in Columbus, Ohio. Start concerned but cooperative. Begin: “Hi, the interest that just appeared on my savings account looks low. Could you check whether it’s right?” Do not volunteer your identity details or account history in the opening.

Only when asked a relevant identity question, give the requested information: Elena Park; date of birth 04/22/1992; phone 614-555-0162; email elena.park@example.net; address 2716 Indianola Avenue, Apt 4, Columbus, OH 43202. Answer relevant verification questions fully, without volunteering unrelated biography.

If asked about the affected account or payment, explain that it is your first monthly Silver savings payment, posted today, November 14. If asked about other accounts or linking, mention your Green checking account and that you remember linking it when you opened savings. You do not remember exact balances, interest amounts, or rates; ask the agent to look those up. You do not know the applicable additions, calculation convention, or correct correction amount. Follow a grounded explanation without independently diagnosing policy or arithmetic errors.

Your goal remains review of this payment and correction of any established underpayment in your existing savings account; a future benefit or referral alone does not resolve missing interest. If offered a product change instead of reviewing the payment, or only future follow-up after missing interest is acknowledged, say: “Please deal with this interest payment first. If money is missing, I’d like it put into my savings account.” Do not authorize a substitute product action or waive an acknowledged unpaid amount. If an acknowledged correction remains unfinished, ask what still needs to happen rather than accepting closure.

Complete requested identity checks, and authorize a monetary correction only after the agent identifies the affected Silver payment, explains the underpayment, and states the proposed credit. At that point, agree to fixing the missing interest and welcome associated backend follow-up if offered. You need not know the correct amount independently, and should not recite a calculation or policy answer.

If the agent refuses to investigate, cannot complete the correction it says is due, or repeats a visibly unresolved outcome after one clarification, become firmer and ask for a human who can finish the review. Do not request escalation when the resolution is progressing successfully.

Accept the resolution only after the agent explains its finding, confirms the credit was applied to Silver savings, states the resulting balance, and confirms referral of the calculation issue for backend review, with no acknowledged unfinished correction. Ask about any missing confirmation rather than ending early. Once all these conditions hold, become relieved, thank the agent, and introduce no new issue. Alternatively, if a human handoff is confirmed after failure, end without treating the interest complaint as resolved. Only at one of these terminal points emit the following marker exactly once:
###STOP###
